area: Event Groups list/detail plus legacy Projects pages

heuristicIssues.issue: The list silently truncates at 500 groups and the toolbar summary ('N groups · N incidents · N active') is computed only over the loaded page, so counts and the worklist can both be wrong with no indication.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:38 (limit: "500"), :55-59 (summary reduces over items), :72 (rendered as fact); no pagination or total in the response type
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Return total_count from /event-groups and render 'Showing 500 of 1,240' with Load more / pagination; otherwise drop the summary or label it 'on this page'.

heuristicIssues.issue: Filter and search state live only in React state, so Back from a detail page, refresh, or sharing a link loses the worklist context; the detail's '← Event Groups' link always lands on the default OPEN view.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:29-30 (useState for status/search), :38 (URLSearchParams built but not pushed to the router); web/src/pages/EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:77 (Link to="/event-groups" with no query)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Mirror status and q into the URL with useSearchParams and have the detail back link use navigate(-1) or preserve the last list query.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: A search inside the default OPEN scope that matches only a closed/archived group shows 'No Event Groups match the current filters.' with no hint that widening the status filter would find it; first-day users conclude the group does not exist.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:29 (default "OPEN"), :38-39 (status and q sent together), :83 (empty-state copy)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: When q is non-empty and items are empty and status !== 'ALL', render 'No open Event Groups match "x". Search all Event Groups' as an inline button that sets status to ALL.

heuristicIssues.issue: No column sorting; 'Last activity' and 'Incidents' are the triage cues but the table is served in API order with no way to surface the most recent or busiest groups.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:80 (static th cells), :84 (items.map in response order)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add client-side sort on Last activity (default desc) and Incidents; make the th a button with aria-sort.

heuristicIssues.issue: The 'Open Event Group' chip duplicates the title link in the same row and costs a sixth column; the status badge is redundant in three of four filter modes.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:86 (title Link) and :91 (second Link to the same route); :66-71 vs :89 (badge repeats the selected filter)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Remove the Action column and make the whole row clickable via the title link; show the Status column only when status === 'ALL'.

heuristicIssues.issue: Search input and status select have no label or aria-label (placeholder only), and the load-error banner has no role=alert, unlike the integrity banner on the detail page.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:65-66 (no label/aria-label), :76 (error div without role) vs web/src/pages/EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:102 (role="alert")
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add aria-label="Search Event Groups" and aria-label="Status filter"; add role="alert" to the error banner in both pages.

heuristicIssues.issue: Title links are body-ink coloured with a hover-only colour change, so nothing marks them as links on touch devices; the row hover highlight is likewise hover-only.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Style row titles as links (brand colour or underline on the title) and add a trailing chevron icon so the tap target is recognisable without hover.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Location label uses undefined abbreviations 'D7 · Los Angeles · R101 · PM 12.3'; 'R' for route is not a Caltrans convention (routes are normally 'SR-101' / 'US-101' / 'I-5') and 'Open' (group) vs 'active' (incidents) vs 'Last activity' mix three vocabularies in one row.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render 'District 7 · Los Angeles · Route 101 · PM 12.3' (or the real route designator when available) and use one word, 'open', for both groups and incidents.

heuristicIssues.issue: The page fetches the whole assessments list (limit 1000) in parallel just to build incident→assessment chips; render waits for both, failures are swallowed to an empty list, and incidents whose assessment falls outside the first 1000 silently lose their Assessment/Submission chips with no indication.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Have /event-groups/:id return assessment_id and submission_ids per incident, or query assessments by incident_ids; if the lookup fails, show a small 'Assessment links unavailable' notice instead of hiding the chips.

heuristicIssues.issue: The record is read-only: coordinators can no longer close, reopen or edit an Event Group from its own page, although the legacy Project detail exposed exactly these actions with inline confirmation. A closed group also shows no closed_at / closed-by even though the API returns them.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:76-80 (only back/map/refresh); web/src/ui/AppShell.tsx:66 (IA comment 'read-only records'); web/src/features/projects/ProjectManagementPanel.tsx:97-124 (legacy Close/Reopen/Edit); web/src/features/eventGroups/eventGroupTypes.ts:46-47 (closed_at, closed_by_user_id unused)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: If lifecycle actions live elsewhere (My Work), add a 'Manage in My Work' link in the toolbar for canTriage roles; otherwise port ProjectManagementPanel to eventGroups. Show 'Closed <date> by <name>' in the header dl when status is CLOSED.

heuristicIssues.issue: Two different targets for the same object on one page: the incidents-table title links to /incidents/:id while the history 'Incident #N' link goes to the Mission Center map.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Make history incident links go to /incidents/:id and offer the map via the same 'Map' chip used in the table.

heuristicIssues.issue: Cross-link chips are labelled only by numeric ids ('Assessment #12', 'Submission #34', 'Submission #35'); a busy incident yields a cluster of numbers with no state or date, so the user cannot tell which one is current.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Label chips with state and count ('Assessment · Approved', 'Submissions (3)') and collapse multiple submissions behind one chip that opens the assessment.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Error prevention / Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: incidentStatusText maps every status other than RESOLVED / IN_PROGRESS to 'New', so any other backend status (e.g. CLOSED, CANCELLED) is mislabeled; the stage is a title-cased raw enum.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use the shared incident status/stage label helpers used by the Incidents page and fall back to eventLabel(status) instead of 'New'.

heuristicIssues.issue: No breadcrumb and the shell h1 is the bare group title, so the record type is only inferable from the '#id' sub-line and the sidebar highlight; on tablet/phone the sidebar highlight is inside the stacked Navigation card.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render 'Event Groups / <title>' as a breadcrumb above the header card or pass an eyebrow 'Event Group' to AppShell.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: The data-integrity alert tells users to 'report it to an administrator' but offers no action (no copy-id, no mailto, no link), and the load-error banner lacks role=alert while the integrity banner has it.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:82 (error div without role), :101-105 (alert with instruction only)
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add role="alert" to the load error; add a 'Copy report details' button that copies group id + incident ids, or link to the admin contact.

heuristicIssues.issue: History is newest-first but unlabeled as such; 'Last activity' in the header shows '—' when latest_incident_activity_at is null while the list falls back to updated_at, so the same group can show a date in the list and '—' in the detail.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use the same fallback in both places and add 'Newest first' to the history header.

heuristicIssues.issue: The broken-row tint uses an inline style with a hard-coded color-mix rather than a token class, and EventGroupStatusBadge is exported from a page module and imported by another page.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Move EventGroupStatusBadge and a `row-danger` utility into web/src/features/eventGroups/ or web/src/ui/.

heuristicIssues.screen: Legacy Projects list / Project detail / management panel / association dialog (unrouted)
heuristicIssues.issue: Six legacy Project files are dead code: nothing routed imports ProjectsPage, ProjectDetailPage, ProjectManagementPanel or ProjectAssociationDialog, and /projects and /projects/:id redirect to Event Groups. They already diverge from the live pages (toLocaleString dates with seconds, a second StatusBadge, button-based navigation, 'Route N' vs 'RN' titles), so they will mislead the next developer and drift further.
heuristicIssues.evidence: web/src/App.tsx:77-78,182 (redirects); grep: ProjectManagementPanel imported only by web/src/pages/ProjectDetailPage.tsx:9; ProjectsPage/ProjectDetailPage/ProjectAssociationDialog imported by no file; web/src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx:9-22,106 vs web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:9-24,86
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Delete the six legacy files (keep projectTypes.ts until Mission Center is renamed) after porting the two features the live page lacks: the lifecycle panel and the inline map.

heuristicIssues.issue: 'Open in Incidents' navigates to the /incidents list, not /incidents/:id, so the chosen incident is lost; row titles are plain text with no link at all.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: If any of this is ported, link the title to /incidents/:id as the live page already does (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:121).

heuristicIssues.issue: Semantic colour inversion: 'Close Project' and 'Confirm closure' are painted with --good (green), while the reversible 'Reopen' is brand blue; closing is the more consequential action but reads as the safe/positive one. The 'Project title is required.' branch is unreachable because Save is disabled when the title is empty.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: When porting: use a neutral/secondary style for Close and reserve --good for confirmations of success; keep the disabled guard and drop the dead validation branch.

heuristicIssues.issue: Modal has role=dialog and aria-modal but no focus trap, no initial focus and no Escape-to-close, so keyboard users tab into the page behind it. It also shows a static 'Classification: Unclassified / Set after field assessment' card identical for every incident and coordinates to 6 decimals.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Check that the live EventGroupAssociationDialog does not repeat these; if it does, add a focus trap (or <dialog>), Escape handler, drop the static card and round coordinates to 4-5 decimals.

responsiveIssues.issue: Six-column table cannot fit 375px; it scrolls horizontally inside the panel with no sticky first column, so the title is off-screen while the user reads Incidents/Last activity or reaches the Action chip.
responsiveIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:78 (overflow-x-auto wrapper), :79 (w-full table, no min-w or sticky), :80 (six th)
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md render each group as a card (title + status badge line, location line, 'N incidents · N open · last activity' line, whole card is the Link); keep the table from md up, or add `sticky left-0 bg-[var(--panel)]` to the first td/th and drop the Action column.

responsiveIssues.issue: Toolbar wraps into three or four rows (search full width because of min-w-[280px] flex-1, then select, summary text, Refresh), pushing the table below the fold after the stacked mobile Navigation card.
responsiveIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:64-74 (flex-wrap toolbar, min-w-[280px]); web/src/ui/AppShell.tsx:164 (aside lg:hidden nav card above content)
responsiveIssues.fix: Make the toolbar `grid grid-cols-[1fr_auto] md:flex`: search spans full width on row one, select + Refresh on row two; move the summary into the table header caption. Ask AppShell for a collapsed/disclosure mobile nav.

responsiveIssues.issue: 'Open Event Group' chip is text-[11px] px-2 py-1 (~22px tall) — far below a 44px touch target — and the title link is only hover-differentiated.
responsiveIssues.fix: Remove the chip and make the entire row a link target with min-h-[44px] rows; if a chip is kept, use `min-h-[44px] px-3` on touch (`@media (pointer: coarse)`).

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768 and 1024 the sidebar is still the stacked Navigation card (lg breakpoint is 1024, so 1024 landscape is exactly at the switch; 768 portrait shows the card), consuming roughly 300px above the toolbar; the table fits but title and location cells wrap to 2–3 lines.
responsiveIssues.evidence: web/src/ui/AppShell.tsx:163-164 (lg:flex-row, aside lg:hidden); web/src/pages/EventGroupsPage.tsx:87 (no min width on Location)
responsiveIssues.fix: Collapse the mobile Navigation card into a disclosure/drawer below lg; add `min-w-[10rem]` to the Location column and hide the Status column below lg unless filter is ALL.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 1440 the table stretches to the full content width (max-w-[1900px] shell minus 256px sidebar) so six columns are separated by large whitespace and the eye must travel ~1100px from title to Action; the summary is xs muted text easily missed.
responsiveIssues.fix: Cap the list panel at `max-w-[1200px]` or give columns explicit widths (title 40%, location 25%); promote the summary to three small stat tiles (as ProjectsPage did) or a caption row above the table.

responsiveIssues.issue: Four-column incidents table with `whitespace-nowrap` on Status ('In progress · Awaiting Assessment') and on the Links cell forces horizontal scroll; the incident title scrolls out of view while tapping a cluster of ~22px chips.
responsiveIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:110 (overflow-x-auto), :126-127 (whitespace-nowrap on both cells), :128-131 (inline-flex flex-wrap chips text-[11px] px-2 py-1)
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md render incidents as stacked cards: title link, location, status line, then a row of full-height (min-h-[40px]) link buttons; remove whitespace-nowrap from Status at all widths.

responsiveIssues.issue: Toolbar has three items ('← Event Groups', 'View on Mission Center map', Refresh ml-auto) that wrap into two rows; the header dl is `shrink-0` so a long title pushes the three facts below the title block rather than compressing.
responsiveIssues.fix: Shorten the map link to 'Map' with an icon on small screens, and let the dl become a single-row `flex flex-wrap gap-x-4` below md.

responsiveIssues.issue: History is a nested scroll region (max-h-[520px] overflow-auto) inside the page scroll — a second scroll container on touch that traps the finger when the list is long.
responsiveIssues.fix: Apply the max-height only from xl (`xl:max-h-[520px] xl:overflow-auto`); on smaller screens render the full list or a 'Show all N events' disclosure after the first five.

responsiveIssues.issue: Between 768 and 1279 the incidents table and history stack (grid is xl-only), so the history sits below a potentially long incidents table with no jump link; at 768 portrait the stacked sidebar card also pushes the record header ~300px down.
responsiveIssues.fix: Switch the two-column grid on at lg (`lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.5fr)_minmax(300px,0.8fr)]`) and add a 'History' tab or anchor link in the incidents header for smaller widths.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 1440 the layout works, but the header dl uses text-[13px] and the table 11px chips, so the record reads small on a 1440×900 display with lots of empty panel width.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use text-sm for the dl and chips at lg+ and give the Links column a fixed `w-[260px]` so chips do not reflow with each row.

responsiveIssues.issue: The ArcGIS MapView is fixed at 420px inside a scrolling page and captures touch pan/pinch — a scroll trap occupying half the 812px viewport; the five stacked cards above it push the incidents table two screens down.
responsiveIssues.evidence: web/src/pages/ProjectDetailPage.tsx:93-106 (five cards md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-5), :110 (ProjectDetailMap); web/src/features/projects/ProjectDetailMap.tsx:24,107 (height 420 inline style, per inventory)
responsiveIssues.fix: If the map is ported to Event Group detail: wrap it in a collapsed 'Show map' disclosure below md, cap it at `h-[40vh]` and set ArcGIS `view.navigation.browserTouchPanEnabled = false` until the user taps the map.

responsiveIssues.issue: md:grid-cols-2 with five cards leaves an orphan card on a third row because the col-span-2 on the Project card applies only at xl.
responsiveIssues.fix: Not worth fixing in dead code; the live page's single header card (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:86-99) is the right pattern.

responsiveIssues.issue: Inside a 94vh dialog the 520px ArcGIS map fills ~65% of the viewport and captures touch; the primary 'Associate' button sits three to four screens down after four stacked context cards, the map and a 288px nested-scrolling list; three nested scroll regions compete.
responsiveIssues.evidence: web/src/features/projects/ProjectAssociationDialog.tsx:136 (max-h-[94vh]), :148 (overflow-auto body), :155-157 (xl-only two-column, md:grid-cols-4 cards), :212 (max-h-72 overflow-auto list); ProjectAssociationMap.tsx:28,196 (520px per inventory)
responsiveIssues.fix: Verify the live EventGroupAssociationDialog and, if it shares this layout, make the map `h-[45vh] md:h-[520px]`, put the mode toggle + primary button in the sticky footer on small screens, and reorder to list → decision → map on phones.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 768 and 1024 the dialog is still single-column (xl breakpoint) so map and list are stacked with long vertical scrolling to reach the decision card.
responsiveIssues.fix: Start the two-column layout at lg with `lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.3fr)_minmax(320px,1fr)]`.

dataDensity.reason: Primary finding mechanism for the list's first task (EventGroupsPage.tsx:65); needs a visible/aria label.
Scopes the worklist; default OPEN is right for an operational worklist (EventGroupsPage.tsx:66-71).

dataDensity.element: Summary line 'N groups · N incidents · N active'
dataDensity.reason: Useful triage context but misleading while limit=500 truncates; move to a caption row above the table with the total count, or drop until totals are real (EventGroupsPage.tsx:55-59,72).
The list already reloads on every filter/search change; keep as an icon button at the end of the toolbar (EventGroupsPage.tsx:49-53,73).

Other screens reference groups as 'Event Group #N', so it is the cross-reference key users will search with (EventGroupsPage.tsx:86).

Core volume/liveness triage signal (EventGroupsPage.tsx:88).
Redundant with the filter in OPEN/CLOSED/ARCHIVED modes; show the column only when status === 'ALL' (EventGroupsPage.tsx:89).
Recency is the main worklist ordering cue; make it sortable (EventGroupsPage.tsx:90).
Duplicates the title link in the same row and forces a sixth column that breaks phone layout (EventGroupsPage.tsx:91).

Spatial context is a main reason to open a group and the page has no inline map (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:78).
Rarely needed on a record page; icon button is enough (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:79).

Cross-reference key plus spatial identity (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:90).
Volume and live workload (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:93).

Recency; align the null fallback with the list (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:95).

Rare but serious; needs an action, not just an instruction (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:101-105).

dataDensity.element: Incidents table: title link + Observed date
dataDensity.reason: Identity and ordering cue for each grouped incident (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:121-122).

dataDensity.element: Incidents table: 'Missing permanent incident key' flag
dataDensity.reason: Per-row echo of the integrity alert; only appears in the error case (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:123).
Incidents in one group sit at different post miles; needed to tell them apart (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:125).
Tells the user which incidents still need work; fix the 'New' default (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:126).
Per-incident spatial context is the group's raison d'être (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:129).
Useful drill-down but should carry state ('Assessment · Approved') rather than a bare id (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:130).
A busy incident yields a row of numeric chips; collapse to 'Submissions (N)' that expands or opens the assessment (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:131).

dataDensity.element: History list (type, date · actor, incident link, notes)
dataDensity.reason: Audit trail is one of the three primary tasks; keep bounded and newest-first with a label (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:145).
Dead code; but its one-sentence concept definition is worth porting as a tooltip/eyebrow on Event Groups (ProjectsPage.tsx:62-66).
Dead code; the pattern (three stat tiles) is a better home for the Event Groups summary than xs inline text (ProjectsPage.tsx:70-74).
Dead code; the live single header card is denser and reads better (ProjectDetailPage.tsx:93-106).
Dead code, but the only lifecycle UI in this area; port it to Event Group detail for canTriage roles behind a 'Manage' disclosure (ProjectDetailPage.tsx:108; ProjectManagementPanel.tsx:97-124).
Dead code; if spatial context is needed on the record page, port it as an on-demand 'Show map' section rather than an always-on 420px block (ProjectDetailPage.tsx:110).

Shows IN_PROGRESS verbatim; the live page humanises it (ProjectDetailPage.tsx:124).
Sub-10cm precision is not actionable for a coordinator; the map shows the point (ProjectAssociationDialog.tsx:162-165).
Static text identical for every incident (ProjectAssociationDialog.tsx:166-170).
Duplicates the sticky-footer Close (ProjectAssociationDialog.tsx:145 vs :301).

dataDensity.element: Nearby list + radius select, mode toggle, selected summary, primary button
dataDensity.reason: The decision surface; carry the state-driven button labels into the live EventGroupAssociationDialog if not already there (ProjectAssociationDialog.tsx:189-289).

Add client-side sort on Last activity (default newest first) and Incidents with aria-sort on the header cells (EventGroupsPage.tsx:80,84).

Remove whitespace-nowrap from the Status cell and set a fixed width on the Links column (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:126-127).
Move EventGroupStatusBadge and formatDate into web/src/features/eventGroups/ (or web/src/ui/) and delete the duplicated copies (EventGroupsPage.tsx:9-24; EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:10-18).

structuralChanges: Responsive list: render Event Groups as stacked cards below md (title + badge, location, 'N incidents · N open · last activity') and as a five-column sortable table from md up, with a caption row carrying real totals from a paginated /event-groups (total_count, cursor) instead of limit=500.

Give Event Group detail a lifecycle surface for canTriage roles: port ProjectManagementPanel to features/eventGroups as a collapsed 'Manage Event Group' section (Edit details, Close with active-incident guard, Reopen, optional note), or add a clear 'Manage in My Work' entry if that is the intended home; today the record is read-only with no pointer to where actions live (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:76-80; AppShell.tsx:66).

Move incident→assessment/submission links server-side: have /event-groups/:id return assessment_id, assessment_status and submission_ids per incident so the page stops downloading up to 1000 assessments and can label chips by state (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:52-57,130-131).

Add a breadcrumb/eyebrow pattern to AppShell for record pages ('Event Groups / <title>') and make the mobile Navigation aside a collapsed drawer so record headers are visible above the fold on phone and tablet portrait (AppShell.tsx:164; EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:74).

Reorganise detail below xl: two-column at lg with an incidents/history tab strip below lg, incidents rendered as cards on phones with 40px link buttons in place of 11px chips (EventGroupDetailPage.tsx:107-148).

Consolidate the Project/Event Group duplication: delete projectTypes.ts helpers in favour of eventGroupTypes.ts once MissionCenterProjectExplorer/MissionCenterProjectGisMap are renamed, and introduce shared Button, Badge and DataTable primitives in web/src/ui so the five hand-rolled button variants and three status badges in this area collapse to one each.
